query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613), 'facts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613), 'notes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613), 'mcqs', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613), 'options', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613), 'verifications', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613), 'flashcards', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0609-0613:%'), 'search_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type='fact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE f.id=d.entity_id AND f.source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613)) OR (d.entity_type='note' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE n.id=d.entity_id AND n.source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613)) OR (d.entity_type='mcq' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_mcqs m WHERE m.id=d.entity_id AND m.source_page BETWEEN 609 AND 613)))) AS batch_counts LIMIT 1;
